# I can't afford every upgrade. Which projects should I fund?

> Free capital budgeting tool for small businesses: list the equipment, vehicle and software projects you want, enter your budget, and get the set with the highest total net present value, with options, must-dos and payback. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
